# The Book of Shadow Work

> A workbook for the part of you that keeps repeating the same pattern. Shadow work and dream therapy by J. Feelgood — written for the overthinkers, ruminators, and quiet criers who sense there is more beneath their practiced story. ISBN 9798283598444.

The site is a single-author book landing page for *The Book of Shadow Work* (paperback, available on Amazon). It includes an introduction to the shadow work method, a seven-step dream therapy practice, three original watercolor artworks by the author, and a free AI-powered Dream Reader tool that interprets stream-of-consciousness writing.

## Pages

- [Home](https://thebookofshadowwork.com/): Landing page. Introduces the book, the pattern-repetition premise, the dream therapy method, the artwork, and the Dream Reader. Primary call to action is purchase on Amazon.
- [Learn More / Dream Reader](https://thebookofshadowwork.com/TBOSW-Learn-More.html): Extended explanation of the dream therapy method, the author's personal story, and the free Dream Reader — an interpretive tool that accepts stream-of-consciousness writing and returns symbols, a shadow invitation, and a question to carry.

## Author

J. Feelgood is an artist and author. The watercolor illustrations (The Mask, The Warrior, The Lady in White) are original works painted by the author and appear inside the book. More work at [jfeelgood.com](https://jfeelgood.com).

## Purchase

The book is available in paperback on [Amazon](https://a.co/d/00Z3mt2Q).
